findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 113 requests to 15 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 6.1 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.0 MB (49%) came from third-party domains, 2.0 MB of it from services classified as tracking (59 requests).

6 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), googlesyndication.com (Google, advertising), mrf.io (Marfeel, analytics), newsroom.bi (Marfeel, analytics), privacymanager.io (LiveRamp, advertising), twitter.com (X, social).
4 cookies were set by third-party domains (10 cookies in total).
A script served from insurads.com read image data from a canvas element. This API is also used for legitimate purposes and does not by itself indicate tracking.
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 4 requests were blocked. The page still made 113 requests to 15 third-party domains, including 6 tracking services in our list.
